title: West Ham denied penalty for Lewis-Potter's hold on Souček
summary: Keane Lewis-Potter held Tomáš Souček in what the KMI panel called "a clear non-footballing action which impacted the West Ham player's movement". The panel said VAR Tony Harrington should have intervened. It also split 3-2 that West Ham should have had a second penalty for Yarmolyuk's challenge on Pablo, but that one was not a VAR error.
consequences: West Ham were reported to be exploring legal action against the Premier League over officiating decisions.
